title: PhD in Computer Science
institution: National University of Singapore (NUS), School of Computing
about: NUS Computing's PhD in Computer Science takes applications year round, with a 15 December cut-off for the August intake. Research Scholarships cover monthly emoluments and full tuition for up to four years for applicants with at least Second Upper Honours.
requirements: August intake cut-off 15 December (January intake 15 June); applications accepted year round for the next intake
Research Scholarship applicants need at least a 2nd Class Upper Honours in computing or a related discipline
Scholarship covers monthly emoluments and full tuition subsidy, renewable annually for up to four years
Outcome about three months after the cut-off; overseas scholarship interviews in mid-March

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "PhD in Computer Science" (doctoral research programme) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Research Scholarship applicants need at least a 2nd Class Upper Honours in computing or a related discipline" → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
